name: FINITE-EXACT
statement: All theorem-core carriers, alphabets, episodes, and certificate data are finite and exact.
nonclaim: No statement about unbounded physical systems.

name: H-DISTINCT
statement: Source and target carrier identities are fixed and distinct before evaluation.
nonclaim: Does not say the target is another person.

name: H-SOURCE-PKG
statement: The source package premise is independently supplied.

name: H-PREDICTIVE-SUFF
statement: The predictive-now vocabulary is sufficient for the declared finite continuation probes.

name: H-ORDER
statement: A carrier-local successor/order relation is declared.
nonclaim: Order alone is not time or consciousness.

name: H-TICK
statement: A viable repeatable tick carrier is declared.

name: H-PROGRESS
statement: The tick carrier admits genuine progress.

name: H-ARROW
statement: An endogenous auditable record/arrow relation is declared.
nonclaim: Holonomy is not substituted for this premise.

name: H-MAINTENANCE
statement: Temporal maintenance resources and ownership are declared.

name: H-BRIDGE-ADM
statement: Cross-carrier component maps satisfy the declared admissibility interface.

name: H-REP-INDEP
statement: Transport is independent of arbitrary representatives at the declared quotient.

name: H-ROUTE-MEMORY
statement: Predictively relevant route residue is retained when route systems are nonflat.

name: H-FLATNESS
statement: Critical pairs join and translation holonomy vanishes for the declared route class.

name: H-CLOCK-REL
statement: Source-local and target-local order/tick coordinates have an explicit typed relation.
nonclaim: No canonical global now is presumed.

name: H-GLOBAL-GLUE
statement: Local clause witnesses satisfy a declared acyclic/running-intersection gluing premise.
nonclaim: Cannot be inferred from local validity alone.

name: H-HARD-GATES
statement: Nonnegotiable clause and viability gates are separately declared.
nonclaim: Not replaceable by a scalar average.

name: H-PACKAGE-OWNERSHIP
statement: Essential final package resources lie inside the target boundary.

name: H-NONREDUNDANCY
statement: Source and target contributions are tested by predeclared counterfactual interventions.
nonclaim: Must not mention the final verdict.

name: H-NO-GAP
statement: Every strict-corridor stage realizes the temporal package.

name: H-WITHDRAWAL
statement: The source, bridge, controller, decoder, scheduler, and undeclared repair are named and removed.
nonclaim: Environment retained by the model remains explicit.

name: H-DISTURBANCE
statement: A finite admissible disturbance class is fixed before evaluation.
nonclaim: Autonomy is relative to this class.

name: H-INVARIANT
statement: A target-owned controlled invariant region is supplied or computed.

name: H-DIRECT-PROVENANCE
statement: The last source event operationally generates the first target event with typed temporal preservation.

name: H-ANCESTRY-SEED
statement: Fallback seed edges are operational and contain no successor-equivalent vocabulary.

name: H-NO-EX-NIHILO
statement: Fallback closure cannot admit disconnected twins solely by similarity.

name: H-FELT-TIME
statement: The felt aspect requires autonomous layer-realized temporal closure.
nonclaim: Explicit hypothesis; not an SBT theorem.

name: H-CONT-TIME
statement: Uninterrupted felt continuity requires episode-indexed continuation of realized temporal closure.
nonclaim: Structural antecedent can be studied; felt conclusion remains assumed.

name: A1
statement: The consciousness paper's objecthood/realization postulate is accepted.

name: A2-P
statement: Substrate indifference is accepted in the intended philosophical sense.
nonclaim: Does not create transport, lineage, or recognition data.

name: H-CERT-SOUND
statement: The finite structural certificate is sound for the intended consciousness-relevant property.

name: H-RECOGNITION
statement: Measurements correctly identify the structural predicates in a real system.

name: H-PERSONAL-IDENTITY
statement: The selected structural relation is sufficient for personal identity or survival.
nonclaim: Not assumed in any structural result.

name: H-BOUNDED-PERTURBATION-BOX
statement: Every robustness perturbation lies inside the declared exact componentwise box and leaves every hard gate unchanged.
nonclaim: Not an empirical noise distribution or open-ended stability theorem.

name: H-TOTAL-INVARIANT-POLICY
statement: The finite autonomy model exposes one target-owned admissible response at every invariant state and disturbance.
nonclaim: Does not establish indefinite physical resource availability outside the model.
